'''Greeve''' was a [[Agriworld/Legends|farm world]] with heavy [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. The population of Greeve were often considered to be "yokels", and over the years they provided manpower for many different armies.
